description:
AirPods desktop user experience enhancement program


1. Fixed the taskbar status window's position and size on non-primary monitors and mixed-DPI multi-monitor layouts. (Issue #217, fixed in PR #218)
2. Fixed the humming or hiss introduced by the v0.5.1 low-latency raw PCM stream by restoring the compatible media playback backend while retaining connection-aware startup, teardown and recovery. (Issue #216, fixed in PR #219)
